description: This file contains a Swift actor 'MicLevelMonitor' that manages microphone input, processes audio levels, and provides an interface for starting and stopping microphone monitoring. It also includes a SwiftUI view 'MicLevelBar' that visualizes the microphone level as a segmented bar.

classes.name: MicLevelMonitor
classes.description: An actor that manages microphone audio input, monitors the audio level, and provides callbacks with the processed audio level.

classes.name: MicLevelBar
classes.description: A SwiftUI view that visualizes the microphone level as a segmented bar.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts monitoring the microphone input, setting up the audio engine, and begins processing audio buffers to determine the audio level. It accepts a callback to send level updates.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the microphone monitoring by removing the tap and stopping the audio engine.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Updates the smoothed audio level and calls the update callback with the latest level.

methods.name: normalizedLevel(from:)
methods.description: Calculates a normalized audio level in the range [0,1] from an AVAudioPCMBuffer by computing RMS and converting to decibels.

methods.name: segmentColor(for:)
methods.description: Determines the color of each segment in the MicLevelBar based on the current level.
